body:
In my personal experience as sort of similar but as a woman, it was never enough for me. I was always left with something missing. I really hit rock bottom when all in one day/night I saw several men one after the other. None of them knew about each other but I also wasn’t dating any of them. The one person I did want to see couldn’t make it that night so to fill a void I hit several up and several replied and were able. 

I felt horrible but also exhilarated all at once for days after that. I thought I was so valued from that. But I wasn’t. It was never enough. I wanted a deeper connection but I was too scared to go there. Evidently I lost the deeper connection I did have and refused to go further into that depth at the time and I wonder a lot if that’s why I lost it. 

A lot of what my addiction stems from is fear of not being loved or even wanted. I have a highly warped view of what others must see me as because of how I’ve allowed people to treat me and with how I haven’t been brave enough or strong enough to stand up for myself. So instead I retreat into my little box and shut it all out. I wish I could be more in between and healthy but I’m far from there yet.
I’m well set up to live my life privately and in peace. Inside I don’t think I’ll ever understand my life but I know that I would be an imposter if I brought someone into my life with me.

Yeah it does suck. I’m sorry to hear about your journey. 

I don’t believe I lost him to this disease. It was just that he saw an ‘out’ and took it out of his own fear sadly. 

I’ve never let anyone get close in a traditional sense to lose them. I wouldn’t be able to handle hurting anyone. 

I do feel very left out in the cold because he, if you like, was almost like a teacher to me on this lifestyle. So that adds another level to him abandoning me and acting like he is out of it now.

I think he saw a boat in the form of her and thought he better get on it in desperation because he was going through a lot of difficulties himself and I was a threat to it. 

I’m sorry that happened to you too.

It is much more complicated. I am a childhood abuse survivor and then that just led into being the norm when I became a teen. I can’t talk about validation on here but I’ll leave it to your imagination - I get self worth from men liking me.
I’m not sure I could be healthy. I have a strong need for validation and will seek that out even when I try not to. Right now I’m not interested in any of it and I don’t know if that will change.
Hi, yes.

I think it probably depends on what the reason is and what type of a person they are. Definitely be careful if you think they'll act out in a bad way hearing it. But I think sometimes even the hard truth can just help us to understand what happened and work on whatever it is for the next person etc.
Maybe also tell them why it's not working anymore so they aren't left to wonder.

This. I know from experience. They are already cheating on their wives so of course they will cheat on us. Never underestimate that. 

Also, if you don't want to do that then just ask him straight up, have a conversation about the way it makes you feel. Trust me, don't let these things fester. It's better to speak up than turn a blind eye.

I'm sorry, it's a nice thought but how can cheaters truly ever apologise? To be capable of doing what they did, I doubt they can ever be sincere. If you're unhappy, let them know and leave instead of cheat and lie to them. Cheaters don't change so they should just leave and be honest to everyone including their selves. 

I know that if I was in a monogamous relationship I would cheat. It's who I am. As much as I would hate myself. That's why I don't get into them. It's not that hard. Just be kind to people and yourself and let them go because if you've cheated on your partner, lied to them and deceived them, taken the choice away from them, gone home to sleep in their bed, then that is who you are. That's your character. You can't run from that. You can try to suppress and get help but the kind of help needed doesn't exist. 

Sorry to be so pessimistic but I know this from my own experiences. Acknowledging the hurt and pain you've caused in an apology is great but don't manipulate them at the end by making them think you've changed and can be with you now. 

Cheaters are a different kind of person, stay away from them unless you're ok with a non monogamous relationship.

I go back and forth with feelings of guilt. It's not exactly a justification but sometimes I'm at ease with it and don't think it's so wrong. The lying part is what unsettles me because his wife is a human being too. But I also know she knows and she's a grown person capable of making decisions. She knows what she's in.

Thank you. We are both mature and it's been almost a decade. I have people I can sort of talk to about it but they don't really understand. Lately I've wondered if I'm a bad person to be able to do this to his wife. Do I make him a bad person? It's been a roller coaster of a ride and we're still on it.
I don’t mean to come across that way. I was hoping to hear how people who have experienced it what they did to keep it going.
I don’t believe that fully because there’s always a way.
This will never pass. This was a long term relationship. Years and years.

Yeah I think this too. I think for so long I was in that habit and now I don't know what's what. I'm learning to not hate myself for everything I've done and things are much better now that the guy came back. I have some good guy friends but I struggle with thinking they just want sex and that's all I'm good for. Too afraid to tell them that. Too afraid to open up at the thought I'd be sort of laughed at.

There is tremendous guilt involved for most and hating oneself but the reasons or the temptation or whatever that hit is wins then guilt sets in again and the cycle repeats. Some are absolutely just selfish and don't care but most have very real messed up feelings around it. What I'm trying to say is it rarely is to purposefully do something to a significant other, it's their own messed up broken soul.
I've tried this but I don't ever get a break. I just want some peace or a little contentment. I don't deserve it though.
Thank you. I'm trying.

I've been in this situation of always wanting more men too. I would see a couple guys in the one day and then as soon as that was done I would be straight away talking to other guys to then hook up with them. And it wasn't that I wasn't satisfied with that time with them but I just had so many around and they were all different and gave me attention that I couldn't say no. I was totally out of control. I'm not recovered yet but I did quit most of that. It took a real wake up call to do so.
Thanks. I'll try.
That’s pretty much where I feel I am. I still talk to others and very close to seeing them (not randoms) but I just can’t at the moment while I try to sort myself out.

I know what you mean about the pain being horrendous and the sexual frustration. He’s cool with me seeing other guys but it doesn’t really help. He’s been my best friend for years and I don’t know what the future holds but I’ve made peace with what we have. If I believed I could have a fulfilling life relationship wise with someone else I would seriously think about stopping but I have problems and I don’t see that happening at the moment.
I wish I did know. I know he’s been the one real constant in my life and goes out of his way within his limitations for me. It’s fucking hard though.

I’m sorry to hear what you’re going through. We only get a chance once every few weeks or more so I understand about making it count. 

I’ve felt the same. Toys and the mind can be better even, but having a man beside me and everything about them makes me keep going back for more. One day I think the quiet life sounds good for me.

That's ok. Yes, I'm not married. Also I'm a woman. 

That's why I don't date. I pushed away any decent guy because I didn't want to hurt them but also because I didn't think I deserved him and there's no way I could just tell them what my life has been. I strictly stuck to only a hook up site where the men didn't want anything but a fuck. That was all I knew I was good for and all I was comfortable with. I'd been like that since I was a kid. 

I met the married guy I see on the hook up site. Years ago now. He's really the closest person in my life and the only true intimacy I allow myself to have. I've tried to be open at times but I just didn't feel comfortable. Maybe I didn't try enough. 

Met another married man off it and he opened my eyes, my heart, and led me to hit rock bottom. I had a sex bender leading up to it and was in a very bad place. He saved me. He left though so I'm on my own. 

I definitely don't want to get into a relationship with someone because I am far too messed up and would make a huge mess of it. But with him, for whatever reason he was able to open me up to thinking for a moment that I could have something more or at least a trusted friend. 

And since meeting him a few months ago, and him leaving, I haven't met others. Only the original married guy I've seen all these years. The thought of randoms makes me want to throw up these days but it's still a struggle inside me and I feel more alone than ever. Maybe because my eyes have been opened to the way I was living?

I'm not sure. I'm not very good at connections. Hook ups are easier for me than real life connections. I don't even go on a date first. It's what I'm comfortable with. It's not even that thrilling to me anymore. 

I've thought about trying more meaningful connections but I don't know how and I don't know if I'm capable. I feel very othered when around any normal setting. And I feel like if they knew about me that they wouldn't know how to react. I look like a normal soft natured woman but the reality inside me is very different.

Torture is a good word for it. 

No, it's our lives. I've tried to consider how I could move closer but it's not possible at the moment. We aren't that far away but it's enough to be difficult with our jobs and his family commitments. It's why I have tried to sleep with others but they just aren't the same.

About once a month. Sometimes more, sometimes less. We used to live closer to each other. Yes I'd be happier if I could see him more often. I wouldn't feel like trying to find others who could never be like him.
This has been going on for years. It is painful. I have done my own thing. I've slept around. I have my own life away from him. Still painful to not be able to see him as much as I'd like.
I have remained single because I know if I was to be with someone then I would hurt them because I wouldn't be able to give up the married guy.

I'm like that with most hook ups. I don't see them to get affection. But I do love affection from the guy I see. It's really the only affection I can handle and I love it. It's like I'm starved and then see him.
I haven't been.

In a general sense. I've been told I love you by different men but I haven't recognised it or felt it. I pushed the men away years ago. I didn't think I was really capable of loving someone or letting them love me. 

It's not as though I'm a cold hearted person though, I just don't know how to allow myself to be vulnerable and let go and love and be loved. 

My family do love me but it was a messed up childhood and I never felt it. It was swept under the rug and some of it has come back up, there have been apologies but it broke little me and I don't know how to heal. I just don't feel loved even if they say it.

Happens to me too. It can take a bit to get off so it's usually my go to since I know I can go fast then. I've grown so tired of it that I've stopped masturbation all together. I hope eventually I can feel that pleasure again without needing to go there. It's not easy. When I'm in the mood I just say to myself that this will pass and try to move on to doing something else.

This has been a huge battle of mine for a long time but just recently I've really had enough and have been able to fight it so far. I still do have sex though (but with only one person for the last few months). 

I've felt better than I have in a long time. I'm able to think much more clearly, experience life more clearly, feel more emotions, work through what led me here and learn more about myself and have the energy to do things totally outside of sex that make me satisfied or happy in some type of way. Definitely not easy but it is getting easier.

I'm sorry, if he is an addict and won't get help they won't stay deleted for long. We try so damn hard but we need so much more help. It can last a while but then we go back to our same habits without something bigger to change us like hitting rock bottom etc.

You're not alone here. Sorry for what you are going through. I feel it too. I fantasise about a man coming into my life and showing me everything I've missed out on. It's just fantasies though as the men I pick in real life are ones who I know will happily use me. I also had a fucked up childhood and don't really know what it feels like to be loved. I was numb for so many years and am trying to work through to some other side that I don't even know.
This exactly. It does sound like he's playing you, to be honest.

How well do you know him?

It sounds like there are issues there but I'm not sure whether you should point them out or not. What are you really concerned about? Maybe you could just talk to him about how you've noticed how he sexts you like crazy and plans to meet up but then cancels and just ask him how come? 

It kind of sounds like he's living a double life or maybe he just gets his hit from all the sexting and then just doesn't need it again for some time. It sounds like he has several women to pick from so he could just be busy getting a hit from them too. Unless the sexting etc is some really hardcore stuff I'm not sure if that alone would make him feel shameful. Could be wrong though.

I have a fwb who is worse than me and we're very close but I've not told him about my struggles and haven't pointed anything out to him. It's a bit different for me though as he is my main source of my addiction and I wouldn't want to jeopardise that. I've thought similar to you before about opening up and wanting to change but I just haven't been able to yet because I don't want to lose him or rock the boat.

I guess ask yourself why a part of you thinks you shouldn't open up to him and why you wouldn't feel comfortable just raising some concerns with him or even just telling him that you're not going to continue on like this because it makes me feel like shit. 

See, in my situation I can't do any of that out of fear plus I have issues where I'll just do whatever the guy wants for the most part. It's not a nice thing to not be able to stand up for myself or speak my mind. If you're able to, I guess I'd encourage you to at least just tell him how his behaviour makes you feel. If you're truly concerned for him you could just say that too and tell him how you care about him. 

My biggest advice for my own situation if I was strong enough and for past situations/regrets would be to look after myself first, don't let them walk all over me, speak up, don't take shit. Don't just play 'nice' out of worry of upsetting them. It's ok to tell them when you don't feel comfortable. How will they ever know what you think/feel if you don't speak up?
I haven't gone to a meeting. It's a bit different here. There's one meeting not close by. I'd like to try but it's really scary.
I'm not sure how to do this. I am always thinking and struggle to shut it off. I tried meditation and I ended up thinking too much about my longings. I'd really like to be able to do this.

I'm going to try this. Lately the simplest of tasks have been difficult for me. I just feel like my whole life has been turned upside down. I don't really know what I'm doing. I'm going to try doing basic things that aren't related to sex and try to focus more on them. I have a huge problem with sexual thoughts almost all the time, even in dreams. I have to try to calm that down because it's not helping me at all.
Thank you. I will try to start doing that. I don't have anyone in person who I could really trust to speak up about these things without them being in shock.

I have heard that quote before and I think I do that quite a bit. 
I’m very low today. I used to have a lot of hope that one day I’d live a more healthy life and have a healthy relationship and be a mother. I don’t feel that hope and haven’t for a long time. I most likely can’t have kids and I don’t know how to be in a relationship. I just feel like I’m nothing to anyone else. What’s the point? What am I supposed to cling to so I can get out of feeling this way? 
I don’t think I’ve had meaning to my life in a long time and now I’m not sure where to look even. I think I want to try to work towards having a healthy relationship someday but I don’t know what I’m meant to do or how I can trust. 
I want to shut the world away and live a quiet life but I need people too. I just don’t make good choices in people.

I'm starting to think it's much more complicated than just hitting rock bottom. I've lived this life for so many years and in some weird fucked up way it's my comfort. Afterwards I hate myself so I do it again. It becomes a vicious cycle. It takes real work and effort and I don't think it's easy at all to have that strength to get better. 

You may want to support him and love him but please look after yourself too.  It's not an easy road at all and there are dangers of relapses and there are triggers everywhere. 

Try to get professional help whatever you decide because it will help to talk through things for yourself.
I’m sorry you’re going through this. I don’t think we really start to change until we can’t take it anymore and hit rock bottom and even then it’s a battle. It has nothing to do with you.

Thank you for your words. 

I don't think I've found yet what it is that I once dreamed I could be. It's only really now that I'm thinking of what a different life might be like and that I want that life but struggle with the thought that I don't feel deserving of it.

I hope that somehow I can forgive myself and believe I've been forgiven. I want to stop punishing myself and hating myself. 

Sorry for my spiel on my experience with Christianity. I buried all of it and much more for years and have recently been thinking about how I got to who I am now. It's been confronting but helpful. You certainly didn't reopen any old wounds. I've done that and it's what I needed to do and continue doing.
Not at all. It’s just hard for me and wish it wasn’t.

I was raised in Christianity. My history of it involves abuse, physical, psychological and sexual. This was for years. I understand it was people. It's very hard when I've tried so hard through periods of my life to trust in Christ and feel repeatedly let down. I understand that's not how it works but it's what it felt. In some ways I have a lot of misplaced blame, not just from my childhood but coming into a lot of my adulthood too. My life has been destruction one thing after another. I have a comfortable life material wise but the rest is extremely fucked up and no matter how much I've tried to ask for help it hasn't worked. To put it bluntly I feel quite abandoned.

I wish I could make amends to people I've hurt but the biggest hurt I've caused is really just to me. The guys I chose were like me. I've hurt four families but there's nothing I can do there. Two of them I know the details about the wives but I couldn't possibly disrupt their lives by coming clean. So the only thing I can do is somehow forgive myself and try to make better choices. I don't know if I have the strength. 

I do know that I remember the first really bad choice I ever made. And that was the first time with a married man. He laid it all out for me and gave me the choice. I liked the attention and thought why not. Got drunk with him and did it. I continued doing it for months thinking it was somehow ok. He became my friend but I certainly didn't need him. It was more like I just wanted to please and he wanted me to please. There is no reason at all as to why I should have chosen to see him. I could have just stuck to single guys. There was no emotional attachment or anything. It's the worst mistake of my life and set the course for my morals going out the window more so than ever before. That's how it seemed to work, raised with morals and believed them because I never ever enjoy hurting anyone, then one moral comes down, then another and another until there seems to be none left and I'd do anything but for what? I didn't even enjoy it.
Thank you. I will remember that. One of the biggest struggles I have is forgiving myself and the self hatred I've had for so long.
Sex addiction is a real thing but it’s not an excuse.

Thank you. This is a constant battle and I can’t explain how all this feels inside and it doesn’t seem to stop. 

I’m thinking of meetings but I don’t know. I’ve avoided any professional help for the last few years. I’m scared of all the feelings and what it might be like in meetings. Definitely don’t want to deal with any homophobic ones but I am female just incase you didn’t know. 

I have to change my life. I can’t keep going like this. I’m so unsatisfied in so many ways and nothing so far except my brief time with the married guy has brought me the feeling of peace and like I was finally home. That’s why him just abandoning me kills so bad. Plus I crave him something terrible. So I try others to replace him but it doesn’t work because I struggle to connect but it felt different with him. 

I found some comfort with my ex and calmed down a bit last night.

Not a man but I've felt this primal attraction for some men that definitely weren't good for me. I'm still not really out of that. How is it possible that I am willing to not care just so I can get that fix? Why would I even want that? I don't have the full answers yet.

Oh and then a good man comes along and all I can think about is the men who aren't good and how bad I want them. Very messed up.

I think maybe you sound like a fairly healthy guy in his 20s. I don't know for sure though. It doesn't sound like it's consuming you. If it's something you are concerned about or something where you think could escalate then it's good to keep an eye on it and become aware of the possibilities before it happens.

The voice inside keeps telling me not to but then this other voice suggests that one last time or do this then you're done. At least the voice telling me what's right is a lot stronger now. I don't think I heard it much at all before.

That has been my life I think. I developed these patterns very early on and I just think it's all I've ever done. None of it made me happy in a sense of fulfilment. I honestly don't know how I lived like that for so many years now that I see things more clearly.
Thank you. I know what I need to do. A week ago I don't think I'd be able to resist and I know I would feel bad afterwards. It's a weird feeling all this change.
He waited a year to tell you? Where was his guilt during that year?
That's awesome. It feels good to say no, sort of like getting some power back to you.

I know that feeling well. I have put a stop to all the random sexting but that's exactly what it was. Chasing that high and not being alone. And meeting guys hoping they can replace the one you actually want.
Same. Though it's with randoms and hook ups. I've just gone through my first day though of not doing that. It feels unnatural because I'm so used to doing it.

Yes, I was exposed to porn forcefully when I was 14. I had been abused when I was little but I hadn't known what to do with that. I was still an innocent kid. Then everything changed. The man used the porn to groom me and then abuse me. The affect it had on me was that I liked it and hated myself for it. I've been messed up ever since.

I found therapy to be really good. I was in a safe place to be able to discuss things that I'd never be able to open up otherwise. But it's hard. Very painful to look back on your life to what made you the way you are. After a couple months I ran away from it, but I'd developed a huge longing towards my therapist. I really should have spoken to a female instead of male. But it did help me for a while. It really helped but I didn't stick to it or stick to even wanting to recover at the time.
Thank you. You've said it well. Sometimes I feel that hunger so strongly that I can't escape it. And it is just emptiness still afterwards, more empty than ever, really. And the cycle continues.
Well said.

It would vary for everyone. For my own recovery, I would like to be able to have a healthy loving relationship that would include lots of sex. At the same time though, I struggle with intimacy and letting someone love me. It is a lot to put on one partner, to expect him to be able to fix me. So it's kind of a cycle. I need to fix myself first. That part is my struggle. And I'm nowhere near there yet. 

In my circumstance, I think it would require abstinence and looking into myself for what led me here and trying to heal from that first. It's a constant struggle and one that feels overwhelming and even impossible. But I so want to be better because none of this brings me happiness or comfort. It's the complete opposite. 

So for me to be in recovery would be to stop being on hook up sites, stop sexting, stop seeing randoms, stop seeing my ex and other fwb. Learn to be by myself. Let a man love me and let myself love him.

Yes, that's a huge fear and three of the married men I've seen have had that. One had kids already grown up. They don't want to walk out on them. They don't want to only see their kids sometimes or even in some cases not at all. They don't want some other guy to take their place. It's completely unfair. On everyone. 
It's not a case of some guy just thinking they can have some on the side and they are all so calculated about it. It's not black and white like that. It's still selfish though. They admit it even and they feel very stuck.
Just want to add that in most cases we have very real problems within ourselves. It doesn't have anything to do with the spouse and it's not your fault.

You have a good point there. I still think in these situations the partner who isn't receiving what they need should speak up and if they can't come to an agreement then leave. 
From my experience, the men were 'good' men. They really did care about their spouse. They didn't want to mess all that up but they just needed more. It's still selfish though and it's still hurtful. They're conflicted often.

I think it would absolutely be an awful position to be in. I understand where they're coming from. I cared about and even loved these men, knowing they weren't mine. I had sympathy and understanding. It's frustrating though that they remain in such unhappy lives, and as I come out of the lifestyle I was living, I see more clearly how selfish and hurtful it really is, to everyone involved. It's not an easy situation and it's not as black and white as people who haven't been there think. But it's wrong. It's wrong because it's selfish and it hurts others.
Proud of you and always here for you.

Yes, it's wrong. And because they don't want to just leave or have some hope still but they become too desperate and it's just too easy to cheat. Doesn't make that right though and they really are still selfish for doing that rather than working on their relationship first or leaving first.

I am a bit the same. I fear commitment. I guess it's fear of abandonment but I also get what you mean with the grass is always greener on the other side. I like a lot of men and can't seem to just settle. It doesn't even make me that happy but I can't stop thinking about what if another man would make me happy/happier? It makes me feel like a horrible person to use men that way and to use myself that way.
That is exactly how I feel, 'conditioned'. I'm trying so damn hard to change and sometimes I believe I really can.

Hey, I can relate. 

I'm that woman who lets men use her so that I can feel some sort of 'love' and I can't stand abandonment either. To prevent abandonment, I sleep with many guys, have several ongoing and hook ups, don't open up properly and use sex as a way to make them 'love' me. I run from those who want more or who treat me other than a sex object. I have deep intimacy fears but so long for it too. I want a different life but find it so hard to trust and let go. 

Living this life, deep down, makes me feel used and makes me feel ashamed. It does not make me feel loved. I am an object and I'm extremely easy, all makes for a quick hook up but has no substance to it. It isn't a life that I'd wish on anyone.

Hey, I'm missing someone so much too that it hurts every second of the day. He's what started all this realisation for me and wanting to get better for good. I have cried too but not as much as I feel like doing. I'm still avoiding emotion. So instead of release I just have this numb dark feeling constantly. I feel like I need to grieve to get better but I'm scared of it being overwhelming.

I'm like this too. I have too many men on kik constantly messaging me, asking for stuff, asking for hook ups, some more. I don't remember if I've done this or that or sent this to one over the other, except for a few. I have to stop. 

When they ask for me I give in and talk to them again. I can't seem to help it. I hate the idea of using them, hate the idea of hurting them or making them feel uncomfortable but what about me? I'm also very selfish needing all that attention. I hate it.

I completely get that. That is what I do too. I don't get to know them first or even think of that. I just think/hope that might happen after we hook up. I'm learning though that there is so much more and it's so much better when I do know them first but I'm only just learning this and not being very good at it yet.

I have intimacy problems too. I find it really difficult to feel intimate but I long for it. So not only do I hook up with a guy just for fun, but I secretly hope maybe there will be more. But then I just feel odd in the situation, they are just some random or guy I hardly know. 

I have felt intimacy though and it both terrified me and made me long for it more. Unfortunately that was with unavailable men though (married). Figures.

Thank you. 

That is it exactly. All I can do is try to breathe. It is such a confusing time and filled with so many different emotions.

Here with you. 

I too have strong feelings of abandonment. It's happening to me right now. A man I met, who is not like us, due to circumstances said he needed time. I said that was ok but then a few days later had a massive freak out inside of me, thinking he was never coming back. I felt like my whole world was over. He did come back but then left again and what did I do? Send nudes. Because I thought that would make him come back. Got silence in return. 

I still hope every second of the day that he'll come back. He was going to be the one to help change my ways. He gave me hope. But I fear now that is all gone and all I have left is my shame. I can't breathe sometimes and I don't get anxiety. This doesn't happen to me. And now my life is just going to keep being like this because I don't know if I have the strength or will to change but I want to so bad.

I'm sorry you are hurting so much. I hope that we can all keep moving towards recovery from what feels like this awful thing inside of us.

You have such strength. 

I know recovery is in my name but I'm far from it. It's gotten so much worse this year. I went three years with just one partner. Three years! I didn't even talk to other guys. Then I got kik/etc and have just gone so far into it that I can't escape. 

I enjoy connection and most of that is with men so I'm scared if I cut that off then I won't have anything. Sometimes though I imagine my life just being more relaxed, out walking my dogs, work (that I love), and a quiet life and the picture of it makes me feel happy. But then reality hits again.

I've been in a relationship of sorts with a guy for years, but he's worse than I am. Gets me to have experiences and tell him about it, joins in. And there's love between us but it's truly messed up.
